scope: Versioned untrained coarse-token/fine-byte fact and value selector. Preserve DG-017 code, four inputs, exact value labels and failed result. No semantic accuracy or training claim.
architecture: Enumerate structurally allowed token spans as before, removing only spans with no legal UTF-8 endpoint. Compute all coarse fact/value probabilities and four token-local boundary score tables before any labels. Fine scores use frozen C features, learned query/source projections and learned within-token byte-offset embeddings, not character dictionaries or whitespace rules.
fine_contract: For selected coarse fact/value spans, normalize four endpoint scores with a bounded log-sum-exp chain subject to fact_start <= value_start < value_end <= fact_end. Decode coarse MAP then conditional fine MAP; do not claim global joint MAP. Compute target NLL by indexing precomputed scores AFTER forward; never gold-condition a neural re-forward.
capacity_policy: Fail closed on limits, invalid UTF-8 or unavailable source boundary. Derive all Unicode code-point cuts from verified full source bytes, including characters split across C tokens. No trimming, regex semantic extraction, labels in masks, or four-endpoint Cartesian tensor. DP transitions bounded by at most65x65 per stage.

Positive cases require connected finite coarse/fine gradients; negative cases route/mode gradients. Zero optimizer updates and unchanged parameter digest. Exact actual prefix IDs remain mandatory; no canonical replacement.
software_gates: DP normalization matches exhaustive tiny oracle
unreachable states produce no NaN gradients
no skipped records or altered value labels
